description: Closed vocabulary of honest check SHAPES. A shape is a named way to resolve a check from graph operands (atoms, ele_ records, registry refs, object.order) — not a second meaning store, not a quiz engine, and not LLM distractors. Realizer stamps the shape + operand refs on the occurrence (ext.check) and/or the occurrence manifest (checks). The HTML projector READS the stamped shape; it does not re-discover pedagogy by if-atom-id.

governance.rule: A check record may only use ids defined here. New values require a version bump and an entry. Do not copy option strings or authored stems onto the element. Prefer keys/refs. Jake parked a distractor-writer; this vocab does not add one.

shapes.label: Invert definition
shapes.definition: Grammatical invert of a definitional first sentence ({subject} is {complement} → What is {subject}?). Key ⊆ the host atom. Contrast ⊆ sibling first sentences in the same store (verbatim). Cloze is a RENDER of this shape when contrast_atom_ids is empty — not a fourth shape.

operands.key_atom_id: atom_id whose first sentence is inverted; the key is that atom’s complement
operands.contrast_atom_ids: sibling atom_ids whose first sentences are closed-contrast distractors; empty → cloze render
operands.host_element_id: the extra reinforce ele_ that hosts this check

shapes.honesty: Key in this atom. Distractors in sibling atoms. Stem is a question transform, not a new SOP fact.

shapes.label: Sequence order
shapes.definition: Order the first sentences of a procedure_step group. Correct order is bindings.object.order (already taught). Projector-only when composing from one atom would be a lie.

operands.element_ids: the existing present ele_ records those atoms occupy (no extra minted)

shapes.honesty: Items ⊆ those atoms’ first sentences. Order is object.order. Prompt is task clothes, not an SOP stem.

shapes.label: Closed choice
shapes.definition: Pick one value from a governed options registry. Key is the instance atom’s selected_value. Options are the verbatim value ids of options_ref on the form atom that instance instantiates. Projector-only when composing from one atom would hide the other half. Prompt is task clothes, not an SOP stem. Do not copy labels onto the element.

operands.options_ref: reg_ id in the client options registry
operands.form_atom_id: atom_id that instance instantiates; carries bindings.form.options_ref
operands.form_element_id: existing form-field present ele_ (no extra minted)
operands.instance_element_id: existing instance exemplify ele_ (no extra minted)

shapes.honesty: Key is the recorded selected_value. Choices are the closed registry value ids. Prompt is task clothes. No invented seventh option.
